identity.philosophy: Fusion over Imitation. Emotion First. Content is King.

headings.usage: Use for all H1-H6. Bold weights (600/800) for impact. Tight tracking.

body.usage: Use for paragraphs, inputs, labels. High legibility.

primary.name: Electric Royal
primary.usage: Primary brand color. Use for active states, key icons, and branding elements.

secondary.name: Signal Orange
secondary.usage: High-urgency CTAs (e.g., 'Get Offer Now'). Creates vibration against the blue.

layout_strategies.spacing: Generous. Use p-8, p-12, p-16. Avoid cramped containers.
layout_strategies.grid: Bento-style asymmetry. Avoid equal 3-column grids. Use col-span-2 vs col-span-1 to create hierarchy.
layout_strategies.container: Max-width 1400px for large screens. 90% width on mobile.

Hero.structure: Split Screen (50/50 or 60/40). Left: Value Prop + Form Step 1. Right: Visual.
Hero.visual: Use the 'Blue Car' image with a subtle 'glass' overlay or clipped geometric shape.
Hero.cta: Embedded Form Step 1 (License Plate or Car Model input) - Immediate action.

EstimationForm.style: Card-based. Clean white background with heavy shadow (shadow-xl).
EstimationForm.progress: Visible progress bar at top. Smooth transitions between steps.

VehicleMarquee.content: Sedan • SUV • Accidenté • En Panne • Sans CT • Fort Kilométrage • Utilitaire
VehicleMarquee.style: Large outline text or bold typography. Opacity 50%.

hero_visual.usage: Hero section right side or background with overlay.

universal_guidelines.interactions: All buttons must have hover states (transform: translateY(-2px)). Inputs must have focus rings.
universal_guidelines.accessibility: Ensure text contrast is > 4.5:1. Use aria-labels on icon buttons.
universal_guidelines.motion: Use framer-motion for step transitions in the form. Animate elements in on scroll.
universal_guidelines.testing: Add data-testid to all inputs and buttons (e.g., 'submit-estimation', 'input-mileage').

instructions_to_main_agent: Create a 'components/layout' folder for the Header/Footer.
Ensure the form state is managed globally or lifted up to the page level.
Implement the 'Swiss Grid' layout for the 'How it works' section.
Use the defined color palette in tailwind.config.js (extend the theme).
